vault_id.description: Skyflow Data Privacy Vault ID that stores tokens and resolves re-identification.

cluster_id.description: Skyflow vault cluster ID. Used to derive the vault base URL (https://{cluster_id}.vault.skyflowapis.com) unless skyflow_base_url_override is set.

account_id.description: Optional Skyflow account ID, sent as the X-SKYFLOW-ACCOUNT-ID header.

env.description: Skyflow environment the vault lives in.

skyflow_base_url_override.description: Override the derived Skyflow base URL (e.g. for a private endpoint).

credentials.description: Credentials. `method` selects one of sts (default), jwt_credential, bearer_token. Under sts the gateway holds NO Skyflow credential: the caller's enterprise IdP token is exchanged (RFC 8693) for a short-lived bearer whose ctx is their signed claims. jwt_credential places an RSA private key on the gateway; bearer_token a long-lived API key with no caller identity. ctx is derived by the plugin under every method and is not configurable.

token_skew_seconds.description: Refresh the cached Skyflow bearer token this many seconds before expiry.

profile.description: Built-in payload template selecting which JSON fields carry user text. 'generic' requires request_json_paths or content_type=text.

request_json_paths.description: JSONPath-lite selectors ($, .key, [*], [n], *) for request text spans to de-identify. Overrides/augments the profile.

response_json_paths.description: JSONPath-lite selectors for response text spans to re-identify. Overrides/augments the profile.

content_type.description: How to interpret the body. 'auto' sniffs; 'json' selects spans via JSONPath; 'text' treats the whole body as one span.

max_body_size.description: Maximum request/response body size (bytes) the plugin will process.

max_spans.description: Maximum number of sensitive text spans per request. Exceeding it fails closed (413) rather than forwarding a partially de-identified body.

entities.description: Entity types to detect (e.g. NAME, EMAIL_ADDRESS, SSN, CREDIT_CARD). Empty = Skyflow's default detector set.

token_format.description: VAULT_TOKEN = reversible, stored, deterministic per value. ENTITY_ONLY = one-way label. ENTITY_UNQ_COUNTER = label + counter.

allow_regex.description: Regex patterns to always allow (never tokenize).

batch_mode.description: How text spans are batched into Detect calls. Only per_span is implemented; spans are de-identified concurrently (see max_concurrency).

reidentify.description: Response-side re-identification behavior. Enabling it implicitly buffers the upstream response.

enabled.description: Restore original values into the response before the client sees it.

strategy.description: mapping_only = pure request-scoped substitution, no extra call. reidentify_text = vault-authoritative via Skyflow /v1/detect/reidentify/string (requires VAULT_TOKEN). detokenize = accepted but degrades to return_tokenized until implemented.

default_treatment.description: Treatment for entity types without an explicit entity_treatment entry.

streaming.description: How streaming responses are handled. 'buffer' collects the full response so tokens can be matched.

deadline_ms.description: Overall Skyflow call deadline (ms). Must be >= timeout_ms.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent Skyflow Detect calls per request. Spans are processed in waves of this width, so request latency is roughly ceil(spans/width) round trips rather than one per span. Must not exceed keepalive_pool_size.

keepalive_pool_size.description: HTTP keepalive pool size for Skyflow connections.

keepalive_idle_ms.description: Idle keepalive timeout (ms) for Skyflow connections.

on_skyflow_error.description: Enforcement posture when Skyflow is unreachable or errors. 'deny' fails closed.

on_parse_error.description: Behavior when the body can't be parsed. 'deny' fails closed; 'skip' forwards untouched.

log.description: Structured logging. Never logs raw values.

sample_rate.description: Fraction of requests to log detection metadata for.
